This compound, in turn, exerts its effect on the G-protein coupled estrogen receptor 1. The integration of these interactions suggests a potential mechanism involving the inhibition of a downstream enzyme, which may modulate the activity of the receptor. The evidence supports a link between Donnaienin and the receptor through a chain of targets, highlighting a possible role in regulating receptor function via the inhibition of a key enzyme. The mechanism is supported by the presence of a direct interaction between Donnaienin and the receptor, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be elucidated.
